observations: Five floating architectural districts and a circular playable route
Central ivory halls with a dominant slender blue roof, paired lower spires, gold crest and trim; entry is a deep arch framed by clustered vertical piers.
Semicircular arrival stair descends to water; curved balustrades, narrow evergreen trees and flower beds give the foot of the palace layered depth.
Ribbed transparent hemispherical dome and small side dome enclose a branching pale tree and suspended gold vessels; circular stone podium.
Open circular blue floor with gold radial mark, tall paired wing-shaped pylons and an elevated gold orrery.
Round ivory multi-storey building with blue hemispherical roof, gold ribs, arched windows, open arrival and projecting telescope.
Oblique upright gold-rimmed portal with purple luminous interior, blue inset panels and paired crystal supports on a stepped terrace.
Broad central crown and distinct outer shelves terminate in long tapered fractured rock masses, with strata and asymmetric buttresses.
Multiple heights of broad wind-shaped tree canopy, fine shrubs, trailing vines and white/lilac flower cascades, with gaps revealing stone.
Cyan pools link short falls and arched bridges above multiple long vertical cascades; narrow white stream edges and mist.
Cloud sea surrounds many distant tapered islets at distinct heights and apparent sizes; blue sky is brighter toward upper left.
Stone bridges visibly link shelves; capstans, brakes and latch geometry are approved functional elaborations, not reliably observable in this image.
Ivory gold-ribbed airship with blue band and hanging banner sits above the city; birds and completion wave are functional elaborations.
